description: High Affinity rate: fraction of docked molecules with top-pose Vina kcal/mol < co-crystal reference redocked score (TargetDiff Table 1 'High Affinity'; TODO-22 metric #3).
scope: pocket-bound docking metric (TODO-22 metric #3) — Phase-1B pocket 4rlu
source: Computed from 20 dock results against reference -6.3730 kcal/mol (residue HCC).
notes: Wf-142 P1 4rlu (2026-09-27): re-docked Wf-140 closure-bounded cohort (n=10) at ex=32 + n_poses=5. Result: 0/10 high_affinity (rate 0.000, no lift, no regress). kcal_min -3.802 (vs Wf-126 P3 baseline -3.796, +0.006 improvement within seed-std noise). Reference -6.373 kcal/mol (HCC co-crystal redocked) is too strong a target for the small closure-bounded fragments — search is converged, not exhausted.

wf126_strengthen.verdict: HONEST-NEGATIVE — closure-bias does NOT lift 4rlu high-affinity rate from baseline 0.45 (unconstrained) → 0.000 (closure-bounded, n=20). FAILS 0.30 uniform floor. Pocket-pharmacophore depth effect: 4rlu is a tetrameric trypsin with 12 histidines; current bias_dict treats it as single-polymer non-metalloenzyme. Wasserstein 0.421 highest across pockets — small known-ligand set (4 ligands). Per-seed n=500 + 4rlu pharmacophore depth deferred to GPU run.

wf142_strengthen.title: Per-pocket high_affinity lift on Wf-140 closure-bounded cohort at ex=32, n_poses=5
wf142_strengthen.verdict: HONEST-NEGATIVE — Wf-142 P1 ex=32 + n_poses=5 lift does NOT break 4rlu closure-bounded rate (0.000 stays 0.000). kcal_min improves +0.006 kcal/mol vs Wf-126 P3 baseline (-3.796 → -3.802, within seed-std noise). The HCC co-crystal reference (-6.373 kcal/mol) is a STRONG target that the Wf-140 closure-bounded fragments cannot reach even at ex=32. Vina stochastic search is NOT the bottleneck (consistent ~[-2.0, -3.8] kcal/mol pose range); the bottleneck is the fragment cohort (closure-bounded small molecules). Honest framing: do not pretend ex lift alone solves the per-pocket high_affinity problem on 4rlu — a SMILES-set lift (stronger binders) is needed.
anti_confusion_guards: NOT cisplatin kcal/mol (separate metric, separate JSON)
NOT Wf-141 v2 (cisplatin exhaustiveness lift, different SMILES set)
